description: Abstract class for bulk import services handling CSV data parsing, entity creation/updating, and saving telemetry and attributes in the ThingsBoard platform.

classes.name: AbstractBulkImportService
classes.description: Abstract class providing bulk import functionality for entities, including CSV parsing, entity creation/updating, and telemetry/attribute saving.

classes.name: EntityData
classes.description: Data class representing parsed CSV record with fields, key-value pairs, and line number.

classes.name: ParsedValue
classes.description: Data class representing a parsed value with its data type, capable of converting to JSON primitives.

methods.name: processBulkImport
methods.description: Main method to process bulk import request, parse data, and handle entity creation/updating asynchronously.

methods.name: saveEntity
methods.description: Saves or updates an entity based on parsed fields, handling permission checks.

methods.name: findOrCreateEntity
methods.description: Abstract method to find or create an entity by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: setOwners
methods.description: Abstract method to set owners for an entity.

methods.name: setEntityFields
methods.description: Abstract method to set fields on an entity.

methods.name: saveEntity
methods.description: Abstract method to persist an entity.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Abstract method to return the entity type.

methods.name: saveKvs
methods.description: Saves key-value pairs, attributes, or telemetry based on CSV data.

methods.name: saveTelemetry
methods.description: Saves telemetry data for an entity.

methods.name: saveAttributes
methods.description: Saves attribute data for an entity.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Parses CSV file into entity data records.

methods.name: shutdownExecutor
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service on bean destruction.
